gathering.ponder.scorekeepers_desk.text_: A Scorekeeper's Desk is where a tournament is run from
Use it to host one, played at the tables near it: players sign up at the desk, and its name floats over it
Anybody else using it is shown the tournament. Another host takes it over by using it twice
With a Display Link on the desk, a board shows its tournament
Choose what it shows: the standings, the pairings, the round and its clock, the final places, the prizes, or who has signed up
A table offers its own match and its game's life totals the same way
A Clipboard used on the desk takes down the round's pairings and the standings
